correctness.rationale: The exact baseline survival and density give a baseline-hazard expansion with leading correction \(u e^{-u}/(1+\theta)\). The standard exponentiated-CDF hazard multiplier contributes only \(-(\alpha-1)e^{-u}/2\) at the same exponential order. Their product yields the stated terminal law. Expanding the exact derivative gives a leading negative term \(-u e^{-u}/(1+\theta)\). Near zero, the published asymptotic gives positive slope for \(\alpha>1\), and direct differentiation does so at \(\alpha=1\).
